title: DOW-UAP-D083, Narrative Statement 5, Western United States Event, 2023 — image (page 005)
blurb: Embedded image extracted from page 005 of DOW-UAP-D083, Narrative Statement 5, Western United States Event, 2023. This memorandum presents the first-hand narrative from Witness 5 provided to the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO). Witness 5 was one of several United States (U.S.) federal law enforcement special agents who reported observing unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP) over a period of two days in October 2023 in the western United States.
